cases.question: ¿Cuánto se facturó por cada tipo de comprobante en febrero de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT si.voucher_type, SUM(si.total_amount) AS total FROM sales_invoice si WHERE si.status = 'Issued' AND si.issued_at >= DATE '2026-02-01' AND si.issued_at < DATE '2026-03-01' GROUP BY si.voucher_type ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT si.voucher_type AS tipo_comprobante, SUM(si.total_amount) AS total_facturado FROM public.sales_invoice AS si WHERE si.issued_at >= CAST('2026-02-01' AS DATE) AND si.issued_at < CAST('2026-03-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY si.voucher_type LIMIT 50

cases.question: ¿Cuánto se cobró por cada medio de pago en febrero de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT pt.name AS medio, SUM(sp.amount) AS total FROM sales_payment sp JOIN payment_type pt ON pt.id = sp.payment_type_id WHERE sp.paid_at >= DATE '2026-02-01' AND sp.paid_at < DATE '2026-03-01' GROUP BY pt.id, pt.name ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT pt.name AS medio_de_pago, SUM(sp.amount) AS total_cobrado FROM public.sales_payment AS sp JOIN public.payment_type AS pt ON sp.payment_type_id = pt.id WHERE sp.paid_at >= CAST('2026-02-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND sp.paid_at < CAST('2026-03-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) GROUP BY pt.name LIMIT 50

cases.question: ¿Cuántos pedidos cerrados para llevar hubo en febrero de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM sales_order so WHERE so.order_type = 'Llevar' AND so.status = 'Closed' AND so.ordered_at >= DATE '2026-02-01' AND so.ordered_at < DATE '2026-03-01' LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT so.id) AS total_pedidos FROM public.sales_order AS so WHERE so.status = 'Closed' AND so.order_type = 'Llevar' AND so.ordered_at >= CAST('2026-02-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND so.ordered_at < CAST('2026-03-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) LIMIT 50

cases.question: ¿Qué productos vendieron más unidades en pedidos cerrados durante febrero de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS unidades FROM sales_order so JOIN order_item oi ON oi.order_id = so.id JOIN product p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE so.status = 'Closed' AND p.sellable = TRUE AND so.ordered_at >= DATE '2026-02-01' AND so.ordered_at < DATE '2026-03-01' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY unidades DESC LIMIT 5
cases.generated_sql: SELECT p.name AS producto, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_unidades FROM public.order_item AS oi JOIN public.sales_order AS so ON oi.order_id = so.id JOIN public.product AS p ON oi.product_id = p.id WHERE so.status = 'Closed' AND so.ordered_at >= CAST('2026-02-01' AS DATE) AND so.ordered_at < CAST('2026-03-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY total_unidades DESC LIMIT 50

cases.question: ¿Cuántos pedidos cerrados se atendieron en cada mesa durante febrero de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT dt.number AS mesa, COUNT(DISTINCT so.id) AS pedidos FROM sales_order so JOIN order_table ot ON ot.order_id = so.id JOIN dining_table dt ON dt.id = ot.table_id WHERE so.status = 'Closed' AND so.order_type = 'Mesa' AND so.ordered_at >= DATE '2026-02-01' AND so.ordered_at < DATE '2026-03-01' GROUP BY dt.id, dt.number ORDER BY dt.number LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT dt.number AS mesa, COUNT(DISTINCT so.id) AS total_pedidos FROM public.sales_order AS so JOIN public.order_table AS ot ON so.id = ot.order_id JOIN public.dining_table AS dt ON ot.table_id = dt.id WHERE so.status = 'Closed' AND so.ordered_at >= CAST('2026-02-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND so.ordered_at < CAST('2026-03-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) GROUP BY dt.number LIMIT 50
